themes_detail.label: Street Sign Safety Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street signs have spiked to 6 complaints THIS WEEK versus a 1.4-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 6.65), suggesting either widespread deterioration or a newly recognized hazard pattern in Greenpoint/Williamsburg that poses pedestrian and traffic safety risks.
evidence: 6 dangling street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over 8 weeks (336% spike, z-score: 6.65)
Spike emerged suddenly this week with no gradual build-up in prior weeks
Street/infrastructure conditions are recurring CB budget requests, indicating systemic underfunding
reporting_angles: Walkthrough of affected blocks to document visible signage hazards; interview DOT about inspection schedules
Check whether recent weather events (wind, snow from past month) triggered widespread deterioration

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor Enforcement complaints have skyrocketed to 11 THIS WEEK compared to a 1.1-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 6.11), suggesting either rapid expansion of unregulated food or street vendors, or sudden enforcement activity that is generating resident complaints.
evidence: 11 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (878% spike, z-score: 6.11)
Mobile Food Vendor complaints also spiked: 8 last week vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (967% spike, z-score: 7.49)
Convergence of two vendor-related complaint categories suggests coordinated enforcement action or vendor activity wave
reporting_angles: Interview Department of Consumer Affairs about recent enforcement operations or licensing changes
Document which street corners or parks have seen new vendor activity and resident backlash

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Building/Facade Defects
themes_detail.summary: Outside Building complaints have surged to 3 THIS WEEK versus a 0.4-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 5.42), indicating a sudden cluster of exterior deterioration, debris, or facade hazards in the district that requires rapid assessment.
evidence: 3 Outside Building complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
92 new DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (50 new buildings, 31 alterations), suggesting active construction that may be generating facade/exterior issues
5 major ULURP rezonings in pipeline, indicating neighborhood under development pressure
reporting_angles: Ground survey of recent construction and renovation sites for falling debris, unsecured scaffolding, or facade deterioration
Interview DOB about whether new construction permits are correlating with exterior complaints

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Maintenance Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Litter Basket complaints have exploded to 6 LAST WEEK versus a 0.4-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 5.67), suggesting either removal of trash receptacles or severe neglect in a sanitation service that residents depend on for street cleanliness.
evidence: 6 litter basket complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 5.67)
Dirty Condition remains top-10 complaint type overall (609 complaints over 90 days), indicating baseline sanitation concerns
Sanitation infrastructure maintenance is an unstated but persistent CB need given repeated infrastructure budget requests
reporting_angles: Map which blocks lost litter baskets or are experiencing overflowing receptacles
Interview NYC Department of Sanitation about service reductions or equipment removal in Greenpoint/Williamsburg

themes_detail.label: Residential Noise Trending Upward
themes_detail.summary: Residential Noise complaints reached 193 three weeks ago (36% above the 142.1-complaint weekly baseline, z-score: 4.64) and remain elevated, indicating a sustained or returning noise issue (construction, bars, nightlife) affecting living quality in the district.
evidence: 193 residential noise complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 142.1 weekly baseline (36% spike, z-score: 4.64)
Residential noise is #3 overall complaint type in district (1,908 total over 90 days), indicating chronic issue
92 active DOB permits including 50 new buildings suggest construction-related noise contribution
reporting_angles: Interview residents on which specific blocks (Williamsburg waterfront? Kent Avenue corridor?) are experiencing the worst disturbance
Track correlation between active construction permits and noise complaint hotspots using DOB/311 geospatial data
